column1: # Assets fetched from upstream (pinned URL and checksum).

#   kind     file | tar | zip | zip:<pattern> (only the matching members, without their folders)
#   dest     ~ = $HOME; for an archive, the directory to unpack into. Outside $HOME it is written as root.
#   instead  - : fetched on every distribution (not packaged on Gentoo);
#            a lib/packages.tsv row: fetched only where that row is - and this run needs it.
